items.title: 13 charged in Vietnam over fake luxury perfume network naming Gucci
items.summary: Vietnamese police in Thanh Hoa province charged 13 people for running an online counterfeit-perfume operation that produced and sold fake Chanel, Dior and Gucci fragrances through disguised e-commerce stores and social accounts; police seized hundreds of counterfeit bottles and about 620 liters of fake perfume liquid. Critical-angle counterweight showing continued brand-protection/counterfeit exposure in the Vietnamese market.

items.title: Gucci unveils new high jewelry collection across four thematic groups
items.summary: Esquire Thailand's descriptive write-up covers Gucci's new high-jewelry collection (Gucci Flora, Gucci Nodo, Everlasting G, Iconic Signatures), highlighting a ruby-and-rubellite poppy suite and the house's use of nature and archive-symbol motifs. Purely descriptive activation coverage with no independent evaluative verdict, scored as neutral per the activation-coverage discount.

items.title: Gucci names Gulf Kanawut Traipipattanapong Thailand brand ambassador
items.summary: WWD's trade report on Gucci naming Thai actor-singer-model Gulf Kanawut Traipipattanapong as a brand ambassador, joining fellow Thai ambassadors Davika Hoorne and Billkin Putthipong, underscoring the brand's continued reliance on Thai celebrity endorsement to drive Southeast Asian engagement. Descriptive activation coverage, retained as background context for the region's celebrity-ambassador strategy despite being outside the tightest freshness window.

items.source: X (via Thai fan/entertainment accounts, aggregated by Sportskeeda)
items.title: Thai fans react on X to Gulf Kanawut and BTS Jin moment at Gucci show
items.summary: Aggregated report on Thai-fan social reaction (X/Twitter) to Thai ambassador Gulf Kanawut's interaction with BTS's Jin at a Gucci Milan show, illustrating persistent K-pop/Thai-fandom-driven SNS volume tied to Gucci ambassador appearances. Fandom-spike coverage; sentiment classifier should damp magnitude per the fandom-trap rule. Retained only as an example of the ambassador-fandom SNS pattern given the scarcity of fresher SEA-specific SNS posts found this run.

items.title: Milan Fashion Week Fall/Winter 2026 recap includes Demna's Gucci debut
items.summary: Grazia Malaysia's regional recap of Milan Fashion Week highlights Demna's runway debut for Gucci among the season's best looks, giving mild independent editorial framing (best-of list inclusion) rather than pure press-release description. Kept as one of the few SEA-outlet items directly evaluating the Demna era; dated, but included since it is a SEA-market outlet's own judgment rather than wire syndication.

items.title: Gucci reopens renovated boutique at Plaza Senayan, Jakarta
items.summary: Indonesian design/lifestyle outlet Sugar & Cream describes Gucci's reopened, renovated boutique at Plaza Senayan mall in Jakarta under the 'Cabinet of Curiosities' interior concept. Purely descriptive retail/interior activation coverage with no evaluative consumer verdict; scored neutral per the activation discount. Retained as the clearest available Indonesia-specific retail signal this run.

items.source: ASEAN NOW forum (Thailand/Vietnam expat discussion board)
items.title: Forum thread on Da Nang counterfeit-Gucci retailer fines continues discussion
items.summary: Community thread on an English-language Southeast Asia discussion board continues to draw comments on Vietnamese authorities fining Da Nang shops for selling counterfeit Gucci, Chanel and Hermes goods, with posters discussing the prevalence of fakes in tourist retail districts and mixed views on enforcement effectiveness. Carried over from a still-active thread; underlying enforcement dates to mid-2025 but community engagement continues within the window.
